tickets.subject: Printer shows error 42 since this morning
tickets.description: Our office printer stopped printing and shows error 42. What can we do?

articles.title: Close a ticket
articles.body: Support closes a ticket when it is solved; a customer can close one under Tickets: open the ticket and choose Close. A closed ticket can be reopened within 14 days of closing. After that, open a new ticket and mention the number of the old one.

articles.title: Printer error 42
articles.body: Error 42 means the print spooler stopped. Open Services on the computer that shares the printer, restart the Print Spooler service, then print a test page. If the error comes back, reinstall the printer driver.

articles.title: Support hours and response times
articles.body: Support answers tickets Monday to Friday, 8:00 to 18:00 CET. The first response to a ticket of priority High is due within 4 business hours, Normal within 1 business day, Low within 3 business days. An outage of a production system can be reported at any time on the hotline named in your contract.

tickets.subject: VPN sign-in rejected
tickets.description: Since today the VPN client rejects my sign-in, although I type the right password.

articles.title: Reset your portal password
articles.body: Choose Forgot password on the sign-in page and enter your e-mail address. The link in the e-mail is valid for 30 minutes. If no e-mail arrives within 10 minutes, check the spam folder; a company administrator can also send a new link under Company > Users.

articles.title: VPN sign-in fails
articles.body: When the VPN client rejects a sign-in with a correct password, the password has usually expired. Reset it in the self-service portal, wait five minutes for it to reach the VPN, then sign in again.

articles.title: Two-factor authentication
articles.body: Two-factor authentication is required for every portal user. It is set up with any authenticator app at the first sign-in. If the phone with the app is lost, a company administrator resets the second factor under Company > Users > Reset two-factor, and the user sets it up again at the next sign-in.

tickets.subject: Rechnungsadresse ändern
tickets.description: Wir sind umgezogen. Bitte ändern Sie die Rechnungsadresse auf unseren Rechnungen auf die neue Anschrift.

articles.title: VAT ID on invoices
articles.body: Invoices show the VAT ID stored under Company > Billing details. A VAT ID added or changed there appears on invoices issued after the change. Invoices to companies in other EU countries are issued without VAT (reverse charge) only when the VAT ID is valid in the EU's VIES register.

articles.title: Change the billing address
articles.body: Company administrators change the billing address themselves: in the portal, open Company > Billing details, edit the address and save. The change applies to every invoice issued after it; invoices already issued keep the old address. If an issued invoice must be corrected, open a ticket with the category Billing and name the invoice number.

articles.title: Download invoices as PDF
articles.body: Every invoice of the last ten years can be downloaded under Invoices: open the invoice and choose Download PDF. To download several invoices at once, select them in the list and choose Download as ZIP. Invoices older than ten years are deleted when their retention period ends.

articles.title: Payment reminders and late fees
articles.body: A first reminder is sent 14 days after an invoice falls due, without a fee. A second reminder follows 14 days later, with a fee of 5 EUR. A payment takes up to 3 working days to be booked, so a reminder that crosses a payment can be ignored.
